- PdfCraft 0.20.0, built from the original release [v0.20.0](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/releases/tag/v0.20.0) without community links (Discord, social networks).

## Fixed
- Everything the original v0.20.0 fixed, see its release notes below.

## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

---

soundcraft.notes:
## Added
- SoundCraft 0.19.0, built from the original release [v0.19.0](https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/releases/tag/v0.19.0) without community links (Discord, social networks).

## Fixed
- Everything the original v0.19.0 fixed, see its release notes below.

## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

---

## Added
- WordCraft 0.17.0, built from the original release [v0.17.0](https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/releases/tag/v0.17.0) without community links (Discord, social networks).

## Fixed
- Everything the original v0.17.0 fixed, see its release notes below.

## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

---
